verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is documented as a self-hosted platform that runs entirely offline, can be deployed anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal), and supports air-gapped setups. Because it runs on infrastructure the user controls, the user implicitly decides where data lives. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses data storage location, storage backends, or residency controls. missing for 10: explicit documentation of where chat, file and memory data is stored and how to configure storage location, residency or region guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of data locality.
